task.title: Hard-enforce Postgres ownership for staging/prod

acceptance: staging/prod startup or config validation rejects json/jsonl owner backends
dev single-VM defaults stay explicitly dev-only
focused tests cover enforcement and allowed dev fallback
runbook records migration and rollback path
